body.body: Post what the team should know: decisions that were made, things that launched or broke, dates or owners that changed, anything the team agreed is worth remembering. Skip working notes, speculation, and anything sensitive or private — if it is not worth remembering next month, it does not belong here. This welcome post stays as the board's first row; do not duplicate it.
body.title: Welcome to the announcement board

description: A chronological board for team news: decisions, launches, and date changes, newest first.
title: Announcement board
